name: Need For Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered

achievements.name: Gold Medal
achievements.detail: Earn a gold medal on a Seacrest County career event.

achievements.name: Ocean Road
achievements.detail: Win a race that runs along Grand Ocean Road.

achievements.name: Hot Pursuit
achievements.detail: Finish a Hot Pursuit event by winning as a racer or busting the field as a cop.

achievements.name: Clean Escape
achievements.detail: Escape the police as a racer and finish that pursuit event.

achievements.name: First Bust
achievements.detail: Shut down a racer during a cop career event.

achievements.name: Spike Strip
achievements.detail: Stop a car by deploying a spike strip in a pursuit.

achievements.name: EMP Strike
achievements.detail: Disable another driver with the EMP during a pursuit event.

achievements.name: Air Support
achievements.detail: Call in helicopter support during a cop pursuit.

achievements.name: Rapid Response
achievements.detail: Complete a Rapid Response event before the timer expires.

achievements.name: Both Careers
achievements.detail: Win one event in the racer career and one event in the cop career.

achievements.name: Full Tour
achievements.detail: Clear every event in one career on the Seacrest County map.
